text: In February 2026, International Holding Company (IHC), the Abu Dhabi conglomerate chaired by Sheikh Tahnoun bin Zayed Al Nahyan, held a 58.11% stake in Alpha Dhabi Holding.
short: IHC holds 58.11% of Alpha Dhabi Holding

source.name: AGBI (Arabian Gulf Business Insight): IHC sets up holding company Judan Financial with $237bn assets
source.quote: IHC holds a 58.11 percent stake in Alpha Dhabi Holding and a nearly 42 percent stake in 2PointZero Group, both listed on the ADX.
